SELECT r.report_id, r.report_title, r.report_type, r.reporter_id, r.admin_id, r.report_status, r.created_at, r.updated_at,
u.user_nickname AS reporterNickname, a.user_nickname AS adminNickname
FROM tb_report r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.reporter_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user a ON r.admin_id = a.user_id
ORDER BY r.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT r.report_title, r.report_content, r.report_type, r.reporter_id, r.reported_id, r.report_action, r.report_status,
u.user_nickname AS reporterNickname, t.user_nickname AS reportedNickname, a.user_nickname AS adminNickname
FROM tb_report r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.reporter_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON r.reported_id = t.user_id LEFT JOIN tb_user a ON r.admin_id = a.user_id
WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId}

SELECT r.report_title, r.report_content, r.report_type, r.reporter_id, r.reported_id, r.report_action, r.report_status,
u.user_nickname AS reporterNickname, t.user_nickname AS reportedNickname, a.user_nickname AS adminNickname

WHERE r.report_id = #{reportId} AND r.reporter_id = #{userId}
